bullets.text: Supported a user base of 20k+ iOS and Android users

Developed CI/CD pipelines using Fastlane and GitHub Actions, improving testing and deployment efficiency by reducing deployment times by over 15 minutes per deployment
Served as the main technical point of contact between two development teams during a parallel backend system transition; delivered technical guidance that resolved 90% of integration roadblocks
Collaborated directly with business to prioritize roadmap features, design intuitive UI flows, resolve issues, and implement custom mobile solutions that addressed real user needs
Improved application reliability by implementing Selenium and improving test coverage of UI/UX features by 30%
Reduced manual testing time by roughly 20% through automation of a regression testing suite using Jenkins
Restructured multiple pages on the front-end Lattice application using YUI (Yahoo's UI library) and Tabulator to improve datatable features
Developed a full stack mobile application originally using Firebase and React Native (2020)
Reengineered the backend system to utilize AWS services: EC2, RDS, S3 and Cognito
Built website using Vue.js and implemented SSR pages to allow for better search indexing
Built a public React Native library to bridge iOS ObjectCapture and PhotogrammatrySession views and classes to the javascript scope
